hypotheses.H0_exact_partitions: Every category scheme exactly partitions the same signed local edge effects within relative error 1e-5.
hypotheses.H1_ranked_profiles_are_stable: The median discovery/evaluation joint-profile cosine among derivative-ranked top-eight heads is at least 0.90.
hypotheses.H2_human_grammar_beats_controls: For ranked top-eight heads, median held-out simple-program fidelity for human categories exceeds both frequency bins and frequency-matched shuffled human categories by at least 0.05.
hypotheses.H3_derivative_importance_predicts_readab: Across all 36 heads, derivative importance and held-out human simple-program fidelity have Spearman correlation at least 0.30.
hypotheses.H4_ranked_heads_have_compact_programs: At least four ranked top-eight heads have a human simple program within 0.10 fidelity of their literal joint route table.
hypotheses.H5_route_types_replicate: At least four ranked top-eight heads have discovery/evaluation top-16 human route Jaccard at least 0.50.
hypotheses.H6_ranked_heads_are_more_stable_than_res: Ranked top-eight median human joint-profile cosine exceeds the other heads by at least 0.05.
